name: @langwatch/identity-eventing
description: The identity platform's event-sourcing layer (ADR-101, ADR-115, ADR-116, ADR-117): the framework envelope over @langwatch/identity's fact payloads, the thin command handlers that run @langwatch/identity-server's guards, the fold projections, the two process managers, and the four pipeline definitions the worker registers. Storage-engine-free - the app supplies every projection store and repository.
